summary: Garry's Mod entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Garry's Mod

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC current Steam build with configured Source content

primary.why: Garry's Mod is a PC sandbox built around Steam/Source content and community add-ons. Windows has the broadest compatibility with Source games, workshop content, and capture tools.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam build on Windows. Record mounted Source games, workshop collection, server/map, and date because the experience is community-content dependent.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC sandbox route with Steam Workshop/community support.
all_releases.reason: primary: the only meaningful archive route, with Windows preferred for compatibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform split; completeness depends on mounted content and workshop/server state.

entries.remaster_caveats: S&box is a spiritual successor, not a replacement for Garry's Mod. Archive notes must list mounted games and addons.
